alertas_cidade.title: City alerts
alertas_cidade.description: Creates flooding sensors per zone (North, South, East, West and Center), counters, the CGE bulletin and cameras for the rain radar and the alert map.

data.geocodificar: Show flooding spots on the map
data.intervalo_adaptativo: Update less often when no rain is forecast

data_description.geocodificar: CGE doesn't publish coordinates. With this option, each flooded street is looked up on OpenStreetMap to find its approximate position.
data_description.intervalo_adaptativo: Every 10 minutes when the CGE forecast shows rain in the next 12 hours, or there is flooding or a region on alert; every 30 minutes otherwise.

data_description.geocodificar: CGE doesn't publish coordinates. With this option, each flooded street is looked up on OpenStreetMap to find its approximate position.
data_description.entidades_proximidade: People, trackers or zones. Each one gets a sensor with how many flooding spots are within the radius. Requires showing flooding spots on the map.
data_description.raio_km: Straight-line distance. Flooding positions are approximate, so start with 2 to 3 km.
data_description.intervalo_adaptativo: Every 10 minutes when the CGE forecast shows rain in the next 12 hours, or there is flooding or a region on alert; every 30 minutes otherwise.

error.requer_mapa: Turn on "Show flooding spots on the map": distance can't be calculated without coordinates.

layout_alterado.title: CGE - SP: the website changed ({parte})
layout_alterado.description:
Couldn't read {parte} on the CGE website ({url}). The page layout has probably changed, and the sensors that depend on it are unavailable.

Error: `{erro}`

This warning goes away on its own once reading works again. If it persists, check HACS for a new version of the integration or open an issue on GitHub.
